name: Acceptance role separation
verification: Final security/production approvals are restricted to authorized roles and cannot be self-approved where separation is required.

name: Evidence integrity
verification: Acceptance evidence references are protected from ordinary alteration/deletion.

name: UAT tenant isolation
verification: UAT/pilot environments and tenants enforce Phase 28 authorization/isolation.

name: Migration credential control
verification: Migration tools use bounded identities/secrets and do not expose source/target credentials to ordinary users.

name: Migration data protection
verification: Migration extracts/staging files follow encryption, retention and cleanup controls.

name: Cutover privileged access
verification: Cutover production access is time/scoped/audited and uses approved operational identities.

name: Go-live approval integrity
verification: Go/no-go records identify actor, authority, time, scope and evidence state.

name: Training data safety
verification: Training environments avoid unapproved production sensitive data.

name: Support privileged access
verification: Hypercare/support elevated access uses audited privileged workflows.

name: Defect privacy
verification: Defect evidence/screenshots/logs do not expose sensitive data beyond authorized need.

name: Risk register access
verification: Sensitive security/contractual risks have appropriate access restrictions.

name: Known issue disclosure control
verification: Internal security-sensitive known issues are not exposed beyond approved audiences.

name: Certification audit
verification: Certification changes, approvals and exceptions are auditable.

name: Evidence export control
verification: Final evidence packages obey classification and access policy.

name: Pilot consent/config
verification: Pilot activation and feature scope are explicit and auditable.

name: Production verification safety
verification: Verification tests avoid destructive or cross-tenant actions in production.

name: Migration deletion safety
verification: Source/staging cleanup occurs only after reconciliation/retention decision and authorization.

name: Release archive integrity
verification: Release archive uses hashes/manifests and protected storage.

name: Incident escalation
verification: Security incidents discovered during UAT/pilot/go-live route through Phase 28/31 incident controls.

name: Break-glass acceptance
verification: Emergency acceptance exceptions are time-bounded, documented and retrospectively reviewed.
